title: Dévissage des complexes ½ simpliciaux ∂ - parfaits et structures multiplicatives… (1975 ou 1976) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting, inferred from pp.68-70. There is an additive category 𝕂 of 'standard' objects. They are probably the Ψ^i indexing a ½-simplicial (semi-simplicial) structure. 𝕂 carries a product * (possibly a join-type product). It sits inside larger categories P_0 and Q = P_1. Those carry a class Σ of distinguished short exact sequences, i.e. an exact-category structure. B is an abelian ⊗-category. At the end of p.68 Grothendieck observes that 𝕂 has no unit for *, so unit compatibilities cannot be stated inside 𝕂. He therefore passes to P_0 or Q.

On this page:
(1) He restricts to complexes (i ≥ 0) C^i → C^{i+1} in B that satisfy a kernel condition on Z^i → C^i (crossed out, then summarised). These correspond to Σ-cartesian, i.e. Σ-left-exact additive, functors P_0 → B resp. Q → B.
(2) A first attempt, struck out, gives the multiplicative structure directly. It asks for maps F(Ψ^0)⊗F(C^i) → F(Ψ^0 * C^i), bifunctorial maps F(X)⊗_B F(Y) → F(X*Y) on P_0×P_0 resp. Q×Q.
(3) The revised approach: with P = P_0 or Q, consider Σ-cartesian functors P → B. Interpret them as additive functors on 𝕂, i.e. as the complexes C in B. This works because every L ∈ P has a Σ-resolution by objects of 𝕂 built from two Σ-sequences 0 → L → I → L' → 0 and 0 → L' → J → L'' → 0 with I, J ∈ 𝕂.

On p.70 this gives F(L) = R^0F(L) = Ker(F(I) → F(J)). This is the standard fact that a left exact functor is determined by its restriction to a cogenerating class of 'injective-like' objects.

The point being prepared: a multiplicative (lax monoidal) structure on F is determined by its restriction to 𝕂. The map F(X)⊗F(Y) → F(X*Y) is uniquely determined by the square through F(I)⊗F(J) → F(I*J). Uniqueness holds because the right vertical map is a monomorphism, which uses that * of Σ-complexes is Σ-acyclic via the Dold–Puppe formulas. Associativity and commutativity then transfer automatically. Only the unit axiom needs new data: a map 1_B → F(Ψ^0) = C^0 landing in Z^0 = Ker(d^0), giving an 'h-⊗-algebra' structure.

The overall aim is to encode strictly unital multiplicative structures on ½-simplicial ∂-perfect complexes as lax monoidal left exact functors on an exact monoidal category.
errors: No mathematical error is visible. The page is mostly crossed-out drafting. The resolution step L → I → L' should be a Σ-short exact sequence 0 → L → I → L' → 0, as the parallel line for J shows. Whether the needed monomorphism property holds depends on the Dold–Puppe argument deferred to p.70 and is not checked here.

ideas.what: Σ-left-exact additive functors on an exact category with a cogenerating subcategory 𝕂 are equivalent to additive functors on 𝕂, i.e. to suitable complexes, via F(L) = Ker(F(I) → F(J)) using two Σ-sequences.
ideas.modern_name: Extension of functors from injectives / R^0 of a functor on a cogenerating class (exact categories, Freyd–Gabriel-type dévissage)
ideas.where_published: Spirit close to Tôhoku (1957) / SGA4 extension arguments; not this exact form

ideas.what: Lax monoidal structure on a left exact functor is uniquely determined by its restriction to the dense subcategory 𝕂, via a monomorphism argument. Associativity and commutativity transfer automatically.
ideas.modern_name: Extension of lax monoidal structures along dense/cogenerating subcategories (Day-convolution-type argument)

ideas.what: Unit problem: the product * on 𝕂 has no unit, so enlarge 𝕂 to P_0 or Q, where the unit becomes a map 1_B → C^0 factoring through Z^0 = Ker(d^0).
ideas.modern_name: Non-unital vs unital monoidal structures; augmentation/unit of cochain algebras (e.g. join with empty simplex as unit)

missed.claim: Part of a program, otherwise unknown in the literature, to encode multiplicative (unital, associative, commutative) structures on ½-simplicial ∂-perfect complexes as lax monoidal Σ-left-exact functors out of an exact monoidal category built from standard objects. This page only sets up the reduction; the unit axiom is left for p.70.

missed.why_it_might_matter_today: It is an early functorial approach to strictly multiplicative cochain-type models via monoidal functors on a combinatorial category. This is loosely akin to later functor-category models for multiplicative cochains. The individual steps here are standard, so historical rather than mathematical interest.

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a drafting step with many deletions. The mathematics is the standard extension of left exact functors from a cogenerating subcategory, plus a remark on units. The interest lies in the unknown overall program of cote 137, not in anything finished on this page.
